description.value: Wine Country Studios is an intimate working studio and gallery perched among vineyards on the edge of Canada's only desert, overlooking Okanagan Lake near Mission Hill Winery. It is owned and operated by Louise Lambert, a Métis artist celebrated as 'The Lady of Light' for her luminous vineyard and landscape paintings in pastel, acrylic, and oils. Touring cyclists exploring the Okanagan wine country can visit the gallery, commission original works, or join plein air painting workshops held at the studio and partner wineries.
